drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un hexagone hachuré ; à droite, un triangle (face $f$) de sommet $s$ et d'arête $a$, avec les drapeaux voisins du drapeau hachuré $r$ marqués $\tau_1 r$, $\tau_0 r$, $\tau_\infty r$ ; légende $r = (s,a,f)$.
drawings.kind: hatched hexagon; triangle with a flag and its neighbours
drawings.notes: Two figures. Left margin: a hexagon filled with heavy hatching. Right: triangle (face f) with vertex s and edge a; inside, the hatched flag r (a small triangle at s) and the neighbouring flags tau_1 r (above, dashed), tau_0 r (right) and tau_infty r (below the edge a, dashed, outside the triangle); legend r = (s,a,f) under it. Dashed strokes as on the page.

drawings.kind: rhombus of two triangles with a flag and its neighbours
drawings.notes: Rhombus u (top), s (left), t (right), u' (bottom) cut by the diagonal a = st. In the upper face f the hatched flag r at s and its neighbours tau_1 r, tau_0 r; tau_infty r below the diagonal, in the lower face. Label a sits in the lower face, under the diagonal.

drawings.notes: Light pencil octahedron: apex T, bottom B, equator L, F, R, K. Which strokes are hidden is not marked; the edges are a reading of faint, doubled strokes (notably K-L and the back edges). Not encoded: the page does not fix the incidences with certainty.

drawings.description: deux arcs de courbe se faisant face. À gauche, un point $s$ relié à un point $t$ situé sur un arc d'extrémités $t'$ et $t''$, avec à l'extrême gauche un point $\sigma t$ ; à droite, l'image par $\lambda$ : un point $\lambda t$ sur un arc d'extrémités $t'$ et $t''$ (traits renforcés), relié à $\lambda^{-1}s = s'$. Entre les deux, une flèche $\xrightarrow[u_\lambda]{\lambda}$ et une flèche de retour $\xleftarrow[u_{\lambda^{-1}}]{\lambda^{-1}}$.
drawings.kind: two facing arcs with points, and the arrows lambda, lambda^{-1}
drawings.notes: Left: arc from t' to t'' through t; s joined to t, sigma t at the far left on the same line. Right: the image arc (strokes reinforced, doubled) through lambda t, with t' and t'' marked; from lambda t a stroke to the right ending in an arrow at lambda^{-1}s = s' (label at the edge). Faint strokes join t to t' and towards t'' on the right arc. Arrows lambda / u_lambda above and lambda^{-1} / u_{lambda^{-1}} below. A small curved arrow at the top left is not drawn.

drawings.kind: stars of triangles, squares cut by a diagonal, a quadrilateral
drawings.notes: Several small figures over the upper half of p. 284 (four bboxes): (1) top centre, a square with one diagonal (thick sides) and a hexagon subdivided into six triangles around a centre marked t, two spokes thick, outer vertices s (top left) and s (bottom); (2) left, a larger star of triangles around a heavy point t, seven spokes, outer edges with gaps; (3) under it, a rhombus cut by its horizontal diagonal; (4) right, a hexagon star with a thick spoke, and a quadrilateral with two thick sides, one vertex labelled t. The labels s_-, t_- of the transcription are not legible on the crops (small overinked letters) and are left out. The stars are schematic: outer vertices by eye.
